name: DS Cluster D10: Fundamentals (Annual + TTM + Cash Flow)
description: Tests: balance_sheet annual, income_statement trailing_twelve_months, cash_flow quarterly/annual/ttm.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D10: Fundamentals — Annual, TTM, Cash Flow
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === BALANCE SHEET ANNUAL ===
bs_a = balance_sheet(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()
assets_a = ffill(bs_a.total_assets)

# === INCOME STATEMENT ANNUAL ===
inc_a = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()
rev_a = ffill(inc_a.revenue)

# === INCOME STATEMENT TTM ===
inc_ttm = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)()
rev_ttm = ffill(inc_ttm.revenue)

# === CASH FLOW QUARTERLY ===
cf_q = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
cfo_q = ffill(cf_q.ncf_operating)

# === CASH FLOW ANNUAL ===
cf_a = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()
cfo_a = ffill(cf_a.ncf_operating)

# === CASH FLOW TTM ===
cf_ttm = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)()
cfo_ttm = ffill(cf_ttm.ncf_operating)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Total Assets (Annual)",
    category="Fundamentals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Annual", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=assets_a)

xy_lines(
    title="Operating Cash Flow: Q vs Annual vs TTM",
    category="Fundamentals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Quarterly", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Annual", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="TTM", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cfo_q, cfo_a, cfo_ttm))
